title: Find gap for Toronto fire station service coverage
method: Project all 84 Toronto fire stations and the Etobicoke district (3 sections, 187.9 km2) to UTM 17N; buffer every station by 2.5 km (stations outside Etobicoke also cover its edges), dissolve, and take Etobicoke minus the coverage (overlay difference): 3.60 km2 (1.9 %) uncovered. Map district, covered area, gaps and stations.
benchmark_defects: The instruction names dataset/fire_stations.geojson; the file is dataset/fire_station.geojson.

No buffer distance is given; the uncovered share ranges from 65 % (1 km) to 0.4 % (3 km). Checks accept any 0.4-5 km distance applied consistently; 2.5 km (the published reference script) is used for the gold.
The 'etobicoke' layer (188 km2) is larger than the former City of Etobicoke (~124 km2) and contains 22 stations, although only 12 have MUN_NAME 'Etobicoke'.
checks: required: a captured polygon layer equals Etobicoke minus the union of d-m buffers around all stations for some d in 0.4-5 km (area IoU >= 0.90, d searched in 50 m steps); <= 0.5 % of the gap within 0.9 d of any station (subset constraint); layers explained as well by the district outline are ignored; inferred true radius equals the stated buffer distance (+-10 %)
